_comment: Bituminous coal (the 'real' coal, the one TFMG can coke). Generated only via DOV large veins, only in biomes that thematically/geologically match coal-forming swamp and old-growth forest environments. Vanilla coal_ore's small-scattered placement has been redirected to lignite (see ../../../minecraft/worldgen/configured_feature/ore_coal*.json), so this vein is the ONLY source of vanilla coal blocks.
_comment_secondary: Solid coal block as the rare 'rich pocket' block, mirroring how DOV's example veins use raw_X_block. Coal blocks reward mining a vein with a more concentrated payout.
_comment_settings: Defaults are tuned to be roughly 1/5 as dense as vanilla coal would be in unrestricted biomes. min/max ore richness lowered from DOV's defaults (0.1/0.3 -> 0.06/0.2), and vein_solidness raised slightly to keep veins less continuous. Combined with the biome restriction, this hits the target 1:5 lignite:bituminous ratio overall.
_comment_conditions: Geologically realistic biome restriction: swamp and mangrove_swamp model the carboniferous-era peat bogs that produced real bituminous coal; dark_forest is the dense old-growth analog. Y range matches vanilla coal's deep placement (-30 to 90), since bituminous deposits sit deep below the surface where they got compressed.
